verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state that the Agent API (with the Sonar endpoint being reformulated into it) returns web-grounded, LLM-generated answers with inline citations in a single call. The Sonar API reference shows `citations` and `search_results` fields in the response. The only community comment questions whether the Sonar launch is a rebrand and does not contradict the capability. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that single-call cited answers work as documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a sourced, LLM-generated answer to a query in a single API call

citations.quote: Get web-grounded answers with built-in citations in one call
Get accurate, up-to-date answers grounded in real-time web search, with inline citations in a single call
